applicabilityBasis.summary: Liquid scUSD represents deposits in the Ethereum Veda collateral strategy vault. Users deposit digital stablecoins and receive a corresponding scAsset; redemption returns collateral through a queue. No legal-issuer obligation to redeem scUSD for fixed national-currency monetary value was identified. Yield on collateral is distributed to protocol gauges; direct holder yield belongs to the separate stkscUSD position. This supports a strategy-vault collateral receipt assessment, not an assertion that liquid scUSD itself accrues yield.

genius.notes: Reviewed October 7, 2026. Non-payment-token/not-applicable follows the sweep strategy-vault/receipt rubric and the GENIUS distinction between monetary value and underlying digital assets. The Ethereum 0xd3dce716f3ef535c5ff8d041c1a41c3bd89b97ae collateral vault accepts USDC, USDT, DAI, GHO and USDC.e; the separate Sonic staking vault accepts scUSD. The primary documents distinguish liquid scUSD from stkscUSD and do not establish an appreciating NAV for liquid scUSD. Protocol/developer branding (Trevee, Rings, Mithras, Veda and Paladin) does not establish a legal issuer entity or domicile, so omit those fields. The assessment is a documented product-mechanics interpretation, not a regulator-issued exemption. Legal issuer, holder rights and any payment-oriented issuance arrangement remain unresolved.
